posts.coverText: 5 uncomfortable but healthy questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: Do you feel like we're growing together or apart?
What is something you think we don't talk about enough?
How do you really feel about our physical intimacy?
Is there something you've been wanting to do as a couple that we haven't done yet?
Do you feel like I respect your boundaries?

posts.coverText: 5 uncomfortable but healthy questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: Do you feel like I prioritize our relationship enough?
Have you ever felt taken for granted in our relationship?
What is one thing I can do to make you feel more secure in our relationship?
How do you handle it when you're upset with me?
Are you happy with how we spend our time together?

posts.coverText: 5 uncomfortable but healthy questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: What is something you need from me that you're not currently getting?
Have I ever hurt you in a way I might not be aware of?
What are your biggest fears about our relationship?
Is there a past relationship issue you haven't fully resolved?
How do you feel about the way we handle conflict?

posts.coverText: 5 uncomfortable but healthy questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: Do you feel like you can be completely honest with me?
What is one thing you're afraid will hurt our relationship?
How do you feel about the way we handle jealousy?
Is there something you wish I would do more often to show my love?
Do you feel like we're both putting in equal effort into our relationship?

posts.coverText: 5 uncomfortable but healthy questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: Do you ever feel like I don't listen to you?
What's a past argument that still bothers you?
How do you feel about the way we handle our social life as a couple?
Is there a part of your past you're afraid to share with me?
Do you feel like we have enough fun together?

posts.coverText: 5 uncomfortable but healthy questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: Do you feel like our relationship is balanced in terms of give and take?
What is one thing you think we need to work on as a couple?
How do you feel about the way we handle our individual space?
Is there something you're afraid to lose by being in this relationship?
Do you feel like we have enough deep conversations?

posts.coverText: 5 uncomfortable but healthy questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: Do you feel like I respect your opinions?
What is one thing you've been avoiding talking to me about?
How do you feel about the level of spontaneity in our relationship?
Is there a fear you have about our relationship that you've never shared?
Do you feel like we support each other's personal growth?

posts.coverText: 5 uncomfortable but healthy questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: Do you feel like we support each other's dreams?
What is one thing you're hesitant to tell me about your family?
Are you happy with the way we celebrate special occasions?
How do you feel about the amount of time we spend apart?
Is there something you need more of from me emotionally?

posts.coverText: 5 uncomfortable but healthy questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: Do you ever feel like I don't trust you?
What is one thing you wish we did more often as a couple?
How do you feel about the way we handle stress together?
Is there a promise I've made that I haven't kept?
Do you feel like we're aligned in our values and beliefs?
